points.description: Justifies that parent and child are separate/independent processes, so the parent can do whatever it wants, including calling exec (exec in the parent replaces only the parent's image and does not affect the child).
points.partial_credit: Half credit (0.75) if justification is vague, e.g. says parent can call exec after fork but gives no reason about separate processes.

rubric.notes: Full marks: answer says True and explains in any wording that parent and child are separate processes so the parent is free to call exec. Part marks: True with a vague or incomplete reason. Zero: False, or True with no justification or a wrong one (per the question, no correct justification means no marks).
